samples.question: This picture shows a network of round junctions joined by grey wires. A wire runs from one junction to another and may bend on the way, but wires only meet at junctions and the wiring contains no loop, so between any two junctions there is exactly one route through the network. One junction is green and one junction is red. Three junctions are coloured blue, orange and purple; all remaining junctions are dark grey. Travel only along the wires. Where you sit in the picture does not matter, only what the wires connect. Exactly one of the blue, orange and purple junctions is passed through on the route from the green junction to the red junction. Which coloured junction is on that route? Answer blue, orange, or purple.
